'''Unstable Dragon Armor''' is a {{Legendary}} [[Armor]] set that is focused on {{Stat|crit Chance}} and {{stat|crit damage}}. The full set can be crafted from 240 [[Unstable Dragon Fragment]]s and is one of the eight [[Dragon Armors|Dragon Armor]] sets. It has an ability where it occasionally strikes nearby mobs with lightning. This ability does not work on private islands.

You require at least {{Skl|Combat}} 16 (XVI) to be able to use this set and, if a dungeon item, {{skl|Catacombs}} 10 (X) to be able to use this set while in [[Dungeons]].

== Tips ==
*This is a good cheap alternative to Shadow Assassin armor in Dungeons, as it gives similar EHP and gives a lot of Crit Chance and Crit Damage, which makes it complement the Flower of Truth quite nicely.
*Players tend to buy [[Shadow Assassin Armor]] as the next step up after this set. Though for those struggling to obtain the former, this is a decent set to hold on to.
*The full set bonus ability will not activate while riding pets such as the rock pet.

== Trivia ==
*The full set bonus used to be able to rack up kills with the [[Raider Sword]], usually on [[Tarantula Spider]]s from [[Tarantula Minion]]s. This allowed mob grinders to gain more drops from the minions, due to [[Enchantments|Looting]], and gain coins in the purse since each kill with the '''Raider Sword''' would grant coins. This was removed by the full set bonus being disabled on private islands.
*The armor set costs {{BZC|240 Unstable Dragon Fragment}}, making it a good choice for a starter armor.
